note: Each route maps a task shape to exact skill names. `evals.should` prompts MUST fire the route; `evals.shouldNot` prompts must NOT. CI runs every one of them, and separately asserts that every name under `skills` exists in the built index, so a route can never recommend a skill that is not installed.

routes.advice: Hypothesis loop, no guess-patching. Find the root cause before editing, and grep every caller of the function you are about to touch.
Brainstorm before plan mode, stress-test the plan, then write it down. Plan goal-backward from what must be true when this is done.
